name: Attio
description: Monitor Attio CRM for team member access and workspace data compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Attio at https://app.attio.com
2. Go to Workspace Settings → Developers → API Keys
3. Create a new API key with read access
4. Copy and enter it below

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Found in Attio Workspace Settings → Developers → API Keys

checks.name: Employee Access
checks.description: Lists Attio workspace members with their access level (admin/member/suspended) and emits per-member evidence.

checks.name: Application Availability
checks.description: Verifies the Attio API token is active and the workspace is reachable via /v2/self.
